# Phaser 4.2.1

This project vendors the unmodified minified Phaser 4.2.1 browser distribution.
It is loaded locally only when a student opens an interactive case scene.
There is no runtime CDN dependency. The MIT license is in PHASER-LICENSE.md.

- Official release: https://phaser.io/download/release/v4.2.1
- Release date: July 9, 2026
- Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phaserjs/phaser/v4.2.1/dist/phaser.min.js
- License source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phaserjs/phaser/v4.2.1/LICENSE.md
- SHA-256: `66348b1b5141e49b7d5ebbe688cddcb502eab1cb00f21c538686a5b2c5abe4de`
- Browser SRI: `sha256-ZjSLG1FB5Jt9XrvmiM3ctQLqscsA8hxThoalssWr5N4=`

The investigation scene uses Phaser's Canvas renderer, so it works without a
WebGL-capable GPU. Complete HTML evidence controls remain available if the
library, renderer, or image fails. Numbered pins only open supplied case records;
art pixels never contain additional clues and the canvas never gates completion.

Official API references checked September 12, 2026:

- https://docs.phaser.io/phaser/concepts/scale-manager
- https://docs.phaser.io/phaser/concepts/input
